description: This file defines CMake functions for converting escaped JSON strings into CMake strings, handling escape sequences, quotes, and special characters.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON string with escape sequences into a CMake string, handling quotes, escape characters, and special characters.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Wrapper that retrieves a JSON string reference and converts it to a CMake string using json_string_to_cmake.
